safety_flags.message: The eGFR change is large enough to merit prompt medical review; one result alone does not identify the cause.

may_explain: that trends can matter more than one isolated result
possible contextual factors such as hydration, illness, medicines, exercise, or recent tests
must_not_claim: that the patient has acute kidney injury based on this pipeline alone
next_questions: Any vomiting, diarrhoea, fever, or reduced fluid intake?
Any recent NSAID use, medication change, or contrast imaging?
Any major change in urine output, swelling, breathlessness, or persistent vomiting?
Was the repeat test performed by the same laboratory and under similar conditions?

expected_output.disclaimer: PAIR V1 is a hackathon validation prototype using simulated data. It does not diagnose or prescribe treatment.

_adapter_notes.provenance_label: engine output carries no explicit provenance field at runtime; the gateway stamps pair_deterministic_engine at wrap time. In this fixture the provenance field is pre-stamped to simulate that wrap.
_adapter_notes.note: eGFR is COMPUTED from creatinine + age + sex (81.1 -> 51.2, -36.9%), not taken from hypothetical inputs. Earlier placeholder fixture (76 -> 49, -35.5%) superseded.
